description: In the 8.0 tree, couchbase-cli-bucket-compact.md line 25 still reads 'Only Couchbase buckets can be compacted: Ephemeral and Memcached buckets cannot be compacted.' Memcached buckets were fully removed in 8.0.0, so the sentence constrains behaviour against a bucket type the release cannot have. Harmless in effect but a concrete stale-reference marker; a sweep for other 8.0-tree pages mentioning Memcached buckets is warranted, since this one was found incidentally.
